item.title: STAGE BEYOND BORDERS: Selection of Japanese Performances | Japan Foundation, Manila
item.description: The Japan Foundation (JF) has started the project “STAGE BEYOND BORDERS—Selection of Japanese Performances,” which presents outstanding Japanese stage performances online for people throughout the world who are seeking opportunities to enjoy Japanese stage performances amid the spread of COVID-19.
